# VEDICA - Inbal Hanasab Ayurveda Clinic in Tel Aviv

> VEDICA offers personal Ayurveda consultations with Inbal Hanasab (ענבל הנסב) in Tel Aviv, in Hebrew or English. The clinic provides complementary support for sensitive digestion, sleep, stress, perimenopause, menopause and fertility alongside existing medical care.

Updated: 2026-11-07.

The clinic is at Merhavim Clinic, Arlozorov 82, Tel Aviv, Israel. Inbal is the founder and owner of VEDICA, a certified Ayurveda practitioner, a graduate of PranaVeda School of Ayurveda and a member of the Association for the Promotion of Ayurvedic Medicine in Israel. Her approach combines Ayurveda with traditional Persian-Iranian food and herbal knowledge.

The consultation process starts with two meetings. The first meeting lasts 1.5–2 hours and includes detailed intake and traditional pulse diagnosis. The second meeting lasts 1 hour and presents a personalized plan for nutrition, daily routine, infusions and herbs when appropriate. Optional follow-up and questions between sessions support implementation. Fees are available by enquiry; ask about suitability, appointment availability and the fee for the two meetings before booking.

Care is planned alongside medical, mental-health and fertility care, including IVF. Current medications, diagnoses and relevant blood tests are reviewed before herbs are recommended. Public guides provide general information, not medical diagnosis or a substitute for medical care. The clinic does not advise stopping prescribed medication or medical follow-up, and does not promise cures or fertility outcomes.

## Other Services and Reading

- [Persian medicine](https://vedica-ayurveda.co.il/persian-medicine.html): Traditional Persian food and herbal knowledge and its relationship with Ayurveda.

- [Longevity and Ayurveda stands for events and production companies](https://vedica-ayurveda.co.il/corporate-wellness-lectures.html): Educational tasting stands with Inbal Hanasab for event producers, company activity days, wellness days and conferences, mainly in Tel Aviv. Herbal infusions, spices and conversations about everyday routines and quality of life; the longevity theme does not include medical testing, diagnosis or promises of a longer life. The usual open-stand format is about two hours; location, number of stands, attendance, activity hours, equipment, setup, pack-down and price are agreed in advance. Guests can fill a jar with an herbal infusion blend or spices to take home. Inbal helps them choose ingredients that suit their preferences and needs. There are no product sales. Includes genuine photos from the past Indian Embassy event and a dedicated production-company quote flow. Talks and group workshops in Hebrew or English can be discussed alongside the stand. The Silk Road is the experience’s theme, connecting Indian and Persian food and herbal traditions with Inbal’s experience as an Ayurveda and Persian medicine practitioner and her Persian-Iranian heritage. Also includes a separate photo gallery from a tasting-stand event for Timora (תימורה), a real estate fund, with a link to its official website at https://timora-fund.co.il/.

Meet at Aluf Batslut Alley in Tel Aviv-Yafo. Start with an herbal and spice aperitif and an infusion, then taste at several market stops and explore Silk Road stories, Ayurveda and Persian traditional knowledge. Includes a small take-home herb and spice kit and lunch recommendations. The standard route is wheelchair accessible. Suitable for vegetarians and guests who keep kosher, with dietary needs shared in advance. Contact Inbal directly on WhatsApp for dates or a custom group quote. GetYourGuide also lists dates, prices and booking options.
